correctness.rationale: Two explicit length-two Quot charts cover every geometric fixed point and are equivariantly linearized: cyclic coefficients have r-1 negative directions; multiplication matrices have exactly three traceless negative directions. Their fixed ideals are scheme-theoretic, proving the two disjoint smooth parameter spaces. Invariant transverse local rings and the finite-order Lefschetz formula then prove quotient non-Gorensteinness and the trace identity. Exact finite arithmetic tests reproduced the stated local identities but do not establish the theorem on their own.

value.rationale: This is a global, scheme-theoretic classification of the fixed locus for an exceptional moduli-space involution across all genera and ranks, not a numerical specialization. The structural payoff is a universal codimension-three, index-two non-Gorenstein quotient stratum and a closed Lefschetz character formula. The computation directly answers the geometric question raised by the construction of an otherwise unusual automorphism.
